title: Runner face and one call
summary: HeelTurnEngine~invoke(system, input) returns STATUS TEXT INPUT_TOKENS OUTPUT_TOKENS (tokens are words); profile~identity is SLAM|heelturn-0.1|deterministic|words|0. DiplomacyPlayer uses it in place of a DiplomacyEngine. It receives the same SYSTEM (fixed header + designer prompt) and USER text (RULES MAP STATE LAST RESULTS PLAYER LIST INBOX MEMORY TASK) as any runner and answers in SEND, ORDERS and MEMORY blocks. Every call is fresh: only its own MEMORY block carries forward.
invariants: No referee object and no legal-move list are used or assumed.
Section headers are matched in their fixed order, so rules or mail text cannot open a later section.
Call flow: view, prompt policy, assessment, memory, verify published results, read inbox, Reasoned Thought judge, relations, plan, compose press or check orders, write memory.
Every call logs through oorexx_logging_v0.7 (LogService heelturn, INTERNAL): CALL PROMPT ASSESS MAIL EVENT RELATIONS RELY CANNOT_TELL SEND ORDER_CHECK_FAIL ORDERS MEMORY FAULT.
A syntax fault returns STATUS ERROR with no text, which the framework treats as a failed call (no orders, no mail, memory unchanged).
procedure: source = .DiplomacyPlayer~new(engine, prompts, rules, journal, gameId, seed)
Or run tools/heelturn_game.rex DIPLOMACY_ROOT PROMPT_DIR END_YEAR SEED JOURNAL [LOG] [QUIET]
